prompts.prompt: List the best {category} agencies for {audience}. Give a short reason for each.
How do I {goal} with no dedicated team? Give practical steps.
Compare agency vs in-house for {category}. When does each make sense?
Write an FAQ for {brand} answering: pricing, scope, getting started, results. Use only facts I supply.
Turn these notes into a case study: context, approach, measured result, lessons. Do not invent numbers.
